description: How many credits are left on your HonestHook API key: the free monthly allowance, the purchased balance, when the allowance renews, and what this cycle spent, broken down by endpoint. Requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` — free key at https://honesthook.com/docs#key. Checking the balance costs 0 credits — reading it never changes it.
name: check_balance
title: Check credit balance
